title: A 30-day plan for regulasi
description: A 30-day plan for regulasi: start with the smallest version, run it at a set time each day, and use a weekly review to judge your progress.
answer: When it matters, regulasi lives in three places, and the first one you open is already stale. RuleBook keeps regulasi on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

sections.p: Keep one card with contacts, location, and key numbers that opens without a signal.
Refresh the card monthly, or as soon as a number or address changes.
Once a week, look at the part that breaks most often and shrink the target instead of adding willpower.

list: Pick one fixed time, not “whenever there is room”.
Open RuleBook when that time arrives, not later tonight.
Note one blocker, not a long excuse.
Back up before you switch phones.
faqs: Yes. RuleBook keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
With the shortest piece. Add scope only after two steady weeks.
What if I miss a few days?
Do not wipe history. Resume from the last entry and note one blocker.
